town_house_blue.notes: Building. Front (door, dormer) faces +Z. Collider covers the walls up to the eaves (box centred at y = hy). Stone ground floor 3 m, eaves 6.45 m.

town_house_red.notes: Building, front gable faces +Z; upper floors jetty 0.6 m out over the street. Collider to the eaves, centred at y = hy.

town_house_narrow.notes: Narrow townhouse with a shop front and awning on +Z; line several up with ~5.2 m spacing for a street. Awning sticks 1.5 m out in front (not in the collider).

town_house_corner.notes: Wide L-shaped house: gable wing on the front left, market stall with awning on the front right (+Z). Good on a plaza corner. Collider is the full footprint.

town_clock_tower.notes: Landmark: place once on the main plaza, arched door facing the plaza (+Z). Visible from far away; keep 6 m clear around it.

town_keep.notes: Landmark: round watch tower for a distant hilltop, door faces +Z. Sink the battered base 0.3 m into the slope.

town_bridge.notes: Landmark: stone arch bridge, deck runs along local x (16 m), canal flows along local z under the 8 m arch. Walkable: no collider; the terrain/walk mesh must carry the deck (3.5 m at the centre, 3.2 m at the ends) and the parapet tops (deck + 0.65 m) need thin walls if wanted.

town_canal_wall.notes: Tiles every 8 m along its local x. Water side faces +Z; base at the canal bed, top 3 m above it, back flush with the bank.

town_stairs.notes: Walkable: no collider; the terrain must carry the steps. Rises 3 m from local -z (bottom) to +z (top) over 6 m, 4 m wide incl. 0.4 m cheek walls.

town_market_stall.notes: Customer side faces +Z. Scatter in rows on the plaza, 3.5 m apart.

town_lamp.notes: Street lamp; lantern glass uses fx_glow. Place every 10-14 m along streets, bridge ends and the plaza.

town_planter.notes: Flower planter; scatter along walls, bridge parapets and the plaza edge.

town_fence.notes: Tiles every 3 m along its local x (end posts coincide). Use along the winding hill road.

town_props_cluster.notes: Barrels, crates and a bench; drop beside doors and stalls. Bench faces +Z.

town_cobble_patch.notes: Ground dressing: 8 x 8 m, 0.13 m tall. Tiles on a grid every 8 m over flat-ish terrain (plaza, streets); sink 0.02 m.
